llm.guidance: This skill appears to be an instruction-only description for A/B analysis with no code or known origin. Before installing or providing real data: (1) ask the publisher for a repository/homepage or an implementation — the package currently has no runnable code; (2) test with non-sensitive sample data to confirm behavior; (3) avoid uploading personally identifiable or confidential data to an unknown skill; (4) prefer skills that include source code or a trusted upstream (GitHub release, organization) so you can review exactly what will process or transmit your data.
